race.comment: SHEDRIVESABENTLEY (7) goes well here on her home circuit with a win and two placings from five spins and will be at peak fitness for this staying test. Should find this easier than recent efforts and looks the one they all have run down. GOOD PHILLY (1) grows a leg for hoop Kendall who has three wins and four placings from just ten steers. Again gets the benefit of her 1.5kg claim and should make her presence felt. I DROVE ALL NIGHT (2) broke the maiden status over this track and trip two back before not measuring up at Ipswich last time out. Worth another chance. THE COPS (5) gets 2kg weight relief and only needs some luck navigating from the sticky draw to be playing a role in the outcome. O'CALDINO (4) next best from the favourable draw.
